# SaneScan

> SaneScan is a private document scanner for iPhone and iPad: Apple's document scanner, automatic cleanup, on-device OCR, batch photo import and PDF export. Free to download; the App Store version includes 10 free scans a month, and an optional in-app Pro upgrade removes the limit. No account, and no scan contents go to SaneApps servers. MIT licensed.
